ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Site Visit > Building Demarcation
ui_bugs.issue: Read-only computed field renders 'Multiple MPOE/Terminal' even when how_many_dmarcs is empty. parseInt('')===1 is false so the ternary at line 999 always falls through to 'Multiple MPOE/Terminal'. Should render empty when source is empty.
Always renders 'NO' when number_of_business_units is empty (line 990). Same pattern: should render empty/— when source is empty.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Site Visit > Disable NTE Auto-Assignment
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1002 compares formData.number_of_business_units === 'NO' which can never be true (it's a numeric string). Field always renders 'NO' and logic appears wrong (should likely compare against multi_tenant value).

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > NTE Equipment Attributes > Equipment location
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1044 defaults to 'SUITE' whenever nte_at_terminal !== 'Terminal' (even when empty). Should render empty when source is empty.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Multi Tenant Eligibility > Multi-Tenant Eligibility
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1071 always renders 'NO' when proposed_nte_common_space is empty. Should render empty.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Multi Tenant Eligibility > Customer Handoff Panel Location
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1074 default falls back to 'SUITE' whenever nte_at_terminal !== 'Terminal'. Should be empty when nte_at_terminal is empty.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Multi Tenant Eligibility > Ceiling Height
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1086 parseInt(empty)<10 -> false so always renders 'NO'. Should render empty when ceiling_height not set.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Site Requirements > End User Acceptance
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1104 defaults to 'Yes - EF Offer Accepted' whenever ef_qualified !== 'NO' (including empty). Should render empty when source not set.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Site Requirements > Other Requirements
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1113-1119 always prepends 'NOTE: FOR ANY QUESTIONS ... PLEASE CONTACT: ' and appends employee_info. When employee_info is empty the trailing 'CONTACT: ' looks unfinished. Field is marked filled=true even with no real content.

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Site & Order > Building Contact
ui_bugs.issue: Line 963 uses `value={formData.building_contact || formData.building_owner_contact}` but onChange only updates building_contact. Typing into the field while building_owner_contact is set creates a confusing fallback (you cannot clear it back to empty until you type at least one char). Recommend always binding to building_contact and initializing it from building_owner_contact only via the auto-populate effect (already done at lines 478-480).

ui_bugs.component: SVCL Output > Multi Tenant Eligibility > Est. Fiber Drop Length
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1077 uses `value={formData.est_fiber_drop_length || formData.distance_fbt_to_nte}` same anti-pattern – user cannot clear field while distance_fbt_to_nte is set.

action_items: Guard SVCL Output computed read-only fields: only render the derived value when source field has a non-empty value, otherwise render empty string. Affects Building Demarcation, Multi-Tenant, Disable NTE Auto-Assignment, Equipment location, Multi-Tenant Eligibility, Ceiling Height (MTEI), End User Acceptance.
Fix Disable NTE Auto-Assignment logic at line 1002 – comparing number_of_business_units === 'NO' is incorrect (numeric field).
Refactor Building Contact and Est. Fiber Drop Length to not use the `value={a || b}` anti-pattern (controlled input cannot be cleared).
Consider splitting ASEForm.jsx (1142 lines, >700 guideline) into smaller components – ASECklistTab.jsx, CoordinatorInputTab.jsx, SVCLOutputTab.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: ASEForm.jsx is 1142 lines – split into sub-components per tab.

Read-only computed SVCL fields default to misleading non-empty values when source fields are empty (line 990, 999, 1002, 1044, 1071, 1074, 1086, 1104). Wrap each ternary to return '' when source is empty.
`value={a || b}` pattern on controlled inputs (lines 963, 1074, 1077) prevents user from clearing the field. Use explicit fallback only at initial state, then bind to single source.

Other Requirements at line 1113 hard-codes a long instructional sentence and marks the field 'filled'. This is presentation text, not form data – consider rendering as static text and not persisting in formData.

ASE_OPTIONS.equipmentMounting is reused for both NTE Placement and Fiber Terminal Placement – Fiber Terminal Placement actually uses fiberTerminalPlacement (correct), so naming is fine, but NTE Placement label says 'Placement' while Excel column is 'Mounting'. Verify with PM whether NTE Placement should pull from equipmentMounting or a different enum.
